description:
Compare a trait between Watkins accessions that carry vs lack a gene, per trial: n, mean and median per
group and a Mann-Whitney p-value (exploratory; no correction for population structure). gene: symbol, any
IWGSC RefSeq ID or pangenome gene-model ID. trait: exact name from watkins_phenotypes (e.g. 'Heading time').
name: watkins_gene_trait
